structure.title: Fewer layers between your application and delivery.
structure.body: We run our own API, relay and panel layer on top of Amazon SES. Sending is priced à la carte, without passing on an intermediary's pricing structure. That is how we offer lower prices without selling a copy of every feature other providers have.
points: Self-operated infrastructure: MepMail API, relay and panel.
Sending via Amazon SES, à la carte.
Guided deployment, with no support middleman.

how.title: From the first conversation to your first send, with help from who built it.
items: Create your free account and tell us how you send today. We point you to the right tier and follow the migration with you.
We set up your sending domain with you: DNS records for DKIM and MAIL FROM, verification, and a dedicated API key or SMTP relay credentials.
Send a test through the API or the relay. You follow logs, domains, suppressions and metrics in the MepMail panel.
how.note: Assisted setup usually takes about 15 minutes once you have DNS access; propagation and domain verification can take longer. Automatic verification runs every 15 minutes.

deliverability.title: Your sending identity, your integration.
deliverability.body: Every customer uses their own sending domain, verified with DKIM and MAIL FROM on Amazon SES, with isolated reputation. Choose the HTTPS API compatible with Resend's sending calls, with base URL <api>api-mepmail.je4ndev.com</api>, or the SMTP relay with STARTTLS at <smtp>smtp-mepmail.je4ndev.com:2587</smtp>. The API key is dedicated to your operation.
deliverability.note: API compatibility is not feature parity: inbound, dedicated IPs and SSO are not part of this promise. Inbox placement also depends on your domain, your content and sending reputation.

items.q: I already use Resend. Do I have to rewrite my integration?
items.a: For the compatible sending flows, you can keep the official Resend SDK and just change the base URL and the key. We review your integration during migration to spot features that are not equivalent. We do not promise full feature parity.

No. We set up DKIM and MAIL FROM on the sending domain and track reputation, but the final classification depends on the receiving providers, your content and the domain's history. There is no honest inbox guarantee.

items.q: Is there a contract or a cancellation fee?
items.a: No lock-in. You can cancel without a fee; we agree on stopping the sends and removing the DNS settings where applicable.
The total per message is 1 MB on Free and Starter, 5 MB on Pro and 10 MB on Scale. It applies to the sum of decoded attachments, not to each file separately.

items.q: What happens when I go over the quota?
items.a: On Free and Starter, sending stops at the daily limit. On Pro and Scale, with overage enabled, extra sends are billed at each plan's per-1,000 rate and respect the safety ceiling of 5× the included volume; without overage enabled, they stop at the monthly quota. If you expect volume growth, talk to us first.

items.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
items.a: No. The beta is free — create your account and send your first emails without adding a payment method. Paid plans are billed monthly in USD.
The beta is open: no seat limit, each account is capped at 100 emails per day on the Free plan. For higher volume, talk to us and we agree on a plan.

mcp.title: Let your AI agents send email.
mcp.body: MepMail ships an official MCP server. Claude, Cursor, Codex and any MCP client connect straight to your sending domain — hosted (OAuth, nothing to install) or local (npx @mepmail/mcp).
points: Hosted: connect with OAuth at api-mepmail.je4ndev.com/mcp.
Local: npx @mepmail/mcp with a dedicated API key.
Both modes expose the same tools.
